additional_info.subject: Hubject CDR Rejection: Missing Signed Meter Data on One Port of HUMOL0158 Siemens Sicharge D Charger (DATA_ERROR 022)
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team,
We are experiencing a critical issue with the following charger:
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Charger ID:
“6koRpR”
Serial No.: “MP/S3170003430”
Customer charger ID: HUMOL0158
Customer: MOL Hungarian Oil and Gas Public Limited Company
One of the charger's connectors (ports) (CP2) is functioning correctly and successfully sending Charge Detail Record (CDR) data to the Hubject platform.
However, CDRs originating from the other connector (CP1) are being rejected by Hubject.
This problem is causing significant revenue loss.
Core Problem:
Hubject is rejecting CDRs from the faulty port with DATA_ERROR 022 ("Data Inconsistency"). The stated reason is the absence of signed meter data (SignedMeteringValues). The charger likely sends a "public key," indicating Eichrecht compatibility, but the signed meter data required by Hubject is not included in the CDR from the faulty port.
Details and Observations (HUMOL0158):
Charger ID:
HUMOL0158
Problem:
On the same charger, one port (e.g., Connector Identity Key=1) successfully sends data, while CDRs from the other port (e.g., Connector Identity Key=2) are rejected by Hubject.
Error Code:
Hubject DATA_ERROR 022 ("Data Inconsistency"), with the specific reason: "the sent CDR must contain the SignedMeteringValues."
Observations, suggestions:
If one charging point works and another does not, it might be a
configuration problem for that specific outlet
.
The CalibrationLawDataAvailabilityType parameter is likely set to "EXTERNAL," which implies the expectation of Eichrecht compatibility. The charger sends a "public key," but the signed meter data is missing.
According to the attached screenshot (MOL_Roaming_issue_1.jpg): all the correct transactions are on the HU*MOL*E937*2 (2nd) connector (Kerekharaszt South side), and all the transactions on the 1st connector are incorrect. The incorrect transactions are in red, the good transactions are in white. (Attached one failed and one good transaction log as well: failed_transaction_log.jpg & good_transaction_log.jpg)
this issue occurs on other chargers as well, for example:
ID: 15LEDe; s/n: MP / S4 170003434
Backend System:
Driivz
Question and Request:
Please investigate the configuration of the HUMOL0158 charger, specifically focusing on any differences between the two ports that might affect the transmission of signed meter data.
Is it possible to configure the faulty port exactly like the working port, so that it also correctly sends Eichrecht-compliant signed meter data (MID) to Hubject when CalibrationLawDataAvailabilityType is set to "EXTERNAL"?
What steps do you recommend for a permanent resolution to this issue?
We kindly request your urgent assistance in resolving this problem.
Thank you!
Yours sincerely,
Laszlo Szilagyi

additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
Chargers in RC-CH at Manor are using Hubject as well. To check if maybe they know what to do.
This is not a Sicharge D product failure.
Issue caused by a parameter exchanged between CPO Backend and Roaming platform. This parameter is not sent by the charger.
